title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease: Amount of Wear Forgiveness at Turn-In
content:
**Lease-end billing clause — the amount of wear forgiveness, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Clause.** Wear forgiveness is the excess wear charge billed for the turn-in, never more than the tier's wear forgiveness cap and never below zero, rounded to the nearest cent with a half cent rounded up.

**Terms used**

- *Excess wear charge billed for the turn-in*: the amount of the excess wear charge entered on the lease's posting history when the vehicle came back.
- *The tier's wear forgiveness cap*: the wear forgiveness cap of the lease's tier; each of Kestrel Lease Tier 5 through Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ carries its own figure.
- *Rounding*: the amount is taken to the nearest cent, and an amount lying exactly on a half cent is rounded up; to keep that so, 0.0001 cent is added before rounding.

**The result in words.** The forgiveness is the lower of the excess wear charge and the cap; it is never negative; and it is stated in dollars and cents.

**Worked figures (all inputs hypothetical)**

| Excess wear charge billed | Wear forgiveness cap of the tier | Wear forgiveness |
|---|---|---|
| $640.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 |
| $175.00 | $250.00 | $175.00 |
| $640.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| no excess wear charge | $500.00 | $0.00 |

In the first row the charge exceeds the cap, so the cap is forgiven; in the second the whole charge is under the cap and is forgiven in full; in the last two rows the figure is zero.
